acceptance_checks: For an un-IDed `b'Hello World'` parameter, each covered setup-display mode exits successfully with `BytesWarning` configured as an error.
Setup and teardown output render the bytes parameter as `[b'Hello World']` wherever that mode displays fixture actions.
All un-IDed parameters are formatted through `saferepr`, avoiding implicit `str()` conversion and inheriting bounded, exception-safe representation behavior.
Existing raw-string expectations are updated to quoted representations such as `['foo']` and `['bar']`.
Explicit string IDs remain literal and unquoted, including callable results such as `[FOO]` and `[BAR]`.
The targeted setup-display test suite passes without regressions.
confirmed_decisions: Apply `saferepr` to all raw parameter values that have no explicit ID, not only bytes-like values.
Cache the resulting safe representation rather than the original un-IDed parameter object so both setup and teardown use the same safe text.
Expect bytes parameters to display with their bytes literal representation, including the `b` prefix and quotes.
Accept the intentional output change for un-IDed string parameters from unquoted values to quoted representations.
Preserve explicit IDs from `ids=[...]` and callable `ids=` exactly as currently displayed, without adding quotes.
Cover the bytes regression through the existing mode parametrization for `--setup-show`, `--setup-only`, and `--setup-plan`.
Make `BytesWarning` fatal during the regression and require every covered mode to exit successfully.
summary: Update setup-display parameter handling so every parameter without an explicit ID is converted once with the repository’s `saferepr` utility before being cached and displayed. This prevents implicit `str()` conversion and makes representations bounded and resilient to failing `__repr__` implementations. Consequently, bytes display as `[b'Hello World']` and raw strings become quoted, such as `['foo']`. Preserve explicit list-based and callable IDs literally, without applying `saferepr`, so outputs such as `[FOO]` remain unchanged. Add regression coverage across `--setup-show`, `--setup-only`, and `--setup-plan`, treating `BytesWarning` as an error.
